title: A part request naming a Part Library entry with a non-Vendor source is refused
custom_preconds: Library-only entry E. WO with an approved line. Capture a Vendor-source make-request body for E.
custom_steps:
1. POST /api/work-orders/part/make-request with part_source_type "found" and catalogue_part_id E
  2. POST /api/work-orders/part/change-request on a request of E with part_source_type "found"
custom_expected:
1. 400 "A part from the Part Library must have Vendor as its source."; nothing created
  2. 400 same message; request unchanged
